AVR::disable
Description
Disables the AVR plugin for the current connection. AVR will remain
disabled on the current connection until it is closed or
AVR::enable
is called. This means that the
connection will not be counted by AVR and thus excluded from
statistics gathering.
Syntax
AVR
::
disable
Examples
Related Information
Valid Events:
ALL_EVENTS
